heroHeadline: EU Wildfire Total Holds Near 669,000 Hectares as Romania Extends Cernavodă Energy Alert Through September
heroSubtitle: EFFIS's current-situation page now shows 669,118 hectares burned EU-wide as of 16 September — a minor upward revision of the previously recorded 668,035 ha figure for the same date rather than new growth — still well below 2025's record pace but nearly double the 20-year average for this point in the season. The agency's fire danger forecast for 17-23 September continues to flag very extreme conditions across most of France, the Pyrenees and northwestern Morocco. Romania's energy-sector state of alert, in force since 1 August, remains extended through 30 September as Cernavodă's two reactors stay fully offline with Danube flow still insufficient for a restart. No new wildfire outbreaks, fatalities or evacuations have been confirmed across Spain, France, Italy, Portugal, Greece or Romania through 20 September.
footerNote: Data sourced from official reports, major outlets, and institutional analyses.
